errorCodes.meaning: A position is beyond the end of the face's entries. The details carry the face's entry count. Nothing is written.
The face's version is not `expectedVersion`. Details carry the current version. Nothing is written.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

profileId.description: Unchanged: the face keeps its id. It is now read through persona/profile/get.

promoted.description: For each promoted position, in request order, the pool attribute the entry now references and whether this promote created it. `wasCreated: false` means the holder already kept exactly this value, and the face now shares it with whatever else presents it.

reboundPersonaDids.description: Personas in `contextId` that wore the local face and now wear it from the pool. What they present is unchanged. Absent when none did.

version.description: The face's version in the pool.

Ulid.description: A ULID in Crockford base32, uppercase. Used for `attributeId` and `profileId`. Chosen over a UUID because the leading 48 bits are a timestamp, so a key-ordered scan of the store is also creation-ordered and a `list` needs no secondary sort. Server-assigned on create; a producer MAY supply one to make a create idempotent, and a maintainer MUST reject a supplied value that already exists rather than silently overwriting.
Ulid.title: Ulid

Version.description: A value of the store's monotonic write counter. Server-assigned; a producer never chooses one.
Version.title: Version

schema.description: Make values a context-local face carries reusable: each named entry's value becomes a pool attribute, and the face — which can no longer live inside one context once it references the pool — moves above contexts, keeping its id and staying worn wherever it was. One-way.

contextId.description: The context the local face lives in.

entries.description: Zero-based positions, in the face's `entries`, of the values to promote. Positions are meaningful only against the version the producer read, which is why `expectedVersion` is required.

expectedVersion.description: The local face's version as the producer read it. Required: a position into a face edited since would promote a different value than the holder chose.
